sentences.en: We must all take care to preserve our national heritage.
sentences.zh: 我们必须共同努力保护我们的文化遗产。

sentences.en: We must try to preserve the remains of ancient civilizations.
sentences.zh: 我们必须尽力保护古代文明的遗迹。

sentences.en: A fund was set up to preserve endangered marine life.
sentences.zh: 设立了一项基金来保护濒危海洋生物。
